summary: detectPhaseFromPrompt iterates a map, so a prompt naming two agents resolves to a random phase (go/cmd/evolve-fake-cli/main.go); codexManifestDiffs counts any read error as drift (skillcheck codex.go); TestSeal_RealLedgerCopy seals whatever real .evolve/ledger.jsonl is reachable and assumes 101 lines, so a dev worktree with a small local ledger fails it; commentaudit's directive rule treats any `// Output:` as a directive, even outside an Example test.
title: Small defects round 12 found: fake-CLI phase detection order, skillcheck drift on read errors, a vacuous ledger test, a directive false positive
